product.title: Deluxe Las Vegas Helicopter Night Flight with VIP Transportation
product.description: This premium night helicopter experience combines VIP ground transfers with aerial coverage of the brightest Las Vegas Strip landmarks. After a coordinated hotel pickup window, guests check in at the terminal, complete a short safety briefing, and board for a narrated night route over the Bellagio fountains, Allegiant Stadium, the High Roller, and Downtown's Fremont Street corridor before return transport.
highlights: Deluxe Las Vegas Strip night helicopter route with narration from an experienced pilot.
VIP round-trip transportation from select Las Vegas Strip and Downtown hotels.
Aerial coverage includes Bellagio fountains, MSG Sphere area, High Roller, Allegiant Stadium, and Fremont Street lights.
Preflight safety orientation and terminal check-in support included.
inclusions: Round-trip VIP transportation from select Las Vegas hotels
Helicopter flight over the Las Vegas Strip
All local taxes and terminal fees
additionalInfo: All passengers 18+ must present a valid government-issued photo ID at check-in.
Passengers are weighed at check-in to support FAA-compliant seat balancing.
Flight route may be adjusted for weather or FAA air-traffic restrictions.
Hotel pickup assignment and window are confirmed after booking.

meetingPoint.description: Hotel pickup and drop-off are available from select Las Vegas Strip and Downtown properties; pickup windows vary by hotel and flight time.
meetingPoint.name: Select Las Vegas hotel pickup points

items.title: VIP hotel pickup and transfer
items.description: Driver pickup from your confirmed Las Vegas hotel point and transfer to the helicopter terminal.

items.title: Terminal check-in and safety briefing
items.description: Check in, complete passenger weighing, and attend the pilot-led safety orientation before boarding.

items.title: Bellagio Fountains and central Strip
items.description: Lift off over the Las Vegas Strip with clear nighttime views of Bellagio fountains and surrounding mega-resorts.

items.title: MSG Sphere, High Roller, and LINQ district
items.description: Continue northbound over the High Roller corridor and the bright entertainment zone around the Sphere.

items.title: Allegiant Stadium and south Strip arc
items.description: Bank across the south Strip skyline including Allegiant Stadium and major resort complexes.

items.title: Downtown Fremont Street Experience
items.description: Final leg crosses Downtown Las Vegas for elevated views of Fremont Street's illuminated canopy.

items.title: Return to terminal and VIP drop-off
items.description: Disembark and board return transfer to your original pickup zone.

faqs.question: How long is the helicopter portion of the experience?
faqs.answer: The flight segment is typically around 12 to 15 minutes, with total experience time around 3 hours including transfers and check-in.

faqs.question: Is hotel pickup included?
faqs.answer: Yes. VIP transportation is included from select Las Vegas pickup points confirmed after booking.
